entries.source: Your wife has been turned into a giant, bloated form that towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the floor. The sight and the smell make you retch.
entries.target: 你的妻子变成了一只铁塔般的浮肿怪物。黏液和粘稠的液体从每个孔洞向外渗出，不断滴落在地板上。眼前的景象和扑鼻的气味使你异常反胃。

entries.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the west, to Charred Scar. A fiery volcano that can only spell death...
entries.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这道门似乎通向西方，通向灼烧之痕——一座烈焰翻腾的火山，去了只有死路一条……

entries.source:
This giant golem was constructed by the Halflings during the Pyre Wars to fight the orcs, but was felled by Garkul the Devourer.
Its body is made of marble, its joints of solid voratun, and its sole eye of purest ruby; the other one seems to be missing. At over 40 feet tall, it towers above you.
Someone foolish has tried to reconstruct it, but was unable to complete the task; the golem needs another eye to be complete.
entries.target:
这尊巨型傀儡是由半身人在烈火战争中为对抗兽族制造的，但它却被吞噬者加库尔所摧毁。
它的身躯由大理石制成，关节由坚固的沃瑞钽打造，仅有的一只眼睛由纯净的红宝石构成，另一只眼睛似乎已经遗失。它高达四十多英尺，巍然耸立在你面前。
某个蠢货曾试图重建它，却没能完成；这尊傀儡还需要另一只眼睛才能完整。

entries.source: It seems that your %s is made to fit inside the empty eye socket of Atamathon. This is probably very unwise.
entries.target: 你手中%s的外形看上去似乎可以安装到阿塔玛森的空眼窝内，但也许这样做并不明智。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#As you insert the gem the golem starts to shake. All its systems and magics are reactivating.
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#当你插入宝石时，傀儡开始震动。它的系统和魔法被重新激活了。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#Atamathon walks the world again, but without control.
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#阿塔玛森重新来到了世界，不过它失去了控制。
启动防御系统，瞄准目标，**启动摧毁命令**！

entries.source: This giant golem was constructed by the Halflings during the Pyre Wars to fight the orcs, but was felled by Garkul the Devourer. Someone foolish has tried to reconstruct it, but has lost control of it, and now it rampages in search of its original creators, who are long dead. Its body is made of marble, its joints of solid voratun, and its eyes of purest ruby. At over 40 feet tall, it towers above you, and its crimson orbs seem to glow with rage.
entries.target: 这只巨大的傀儡是半身人在烈火战争期间为对抗兽人而建造的，但被吞噬者加库尔击倒。某个愚蠢的家伙试图重建它，却已失去对它的控制，如今它横冲直撞，寻找早已死去的制造者们。它的躯体由大理石制成，关节由坚固的沃瑞钽制成，眼睛则由最纯净的红宝石构成。它足有四十多英尺高，像铁塔般耸立在你面前，猩红的眼眸似乎闪烁着怒火。

entries.source: YOUR LIFE WILL END, PLEASE DO NOT RESIST!
entries.target: 你的生命即将终结，不要试图抵抗！

entries.source: RESISTANCE IS FUTILE, YOUR WILL BE EXTERMINATED!
entries.target: 抵抗无用，你将被彻底毁灭！

entries.source: PLEASE STAY STEADY AS YOU ARE ERASED FROM THE WORLD!
entries.target: 请你坐稳扶好，等待被移除出这个世界！
阿塔玛森的红宝石眼睛

entries.source:
One of the ruby eyes of the legendary giant golem Atamathon.
It is said it was made by the halflings during the Age of Pyre as a weapon against the orcs. Even though it was destroyed, it managed to deal a crippling blow by killing their leader, Garkul the Devourer.
entries.target:
传奇巨型傀儡阿塔玛森的红宝石眼睛之一。
据说它是半身人在烈火纪为了对抗兽人所造的武器。虽然它被破坏了，但它仍杀死了兽人的首领吞噬者加库尔，给了对方沉重一击。

entries.source: This rock seems to have been sealed off. You need to find a way to open it.
entries.target: 这块石头被封锁了。你需要找到一种方法来打开它。

entries.source: Gorbat, Supreme Wyrmic of the Pride
entries.target: 部落至高龙战士加伯特

entries.source: An orc with scaly skin, claws and a pair of small wings on his back.
entries.target: 一只皮肤布满鳞片的兽人，长有利爪，背生一对小翅膀。
并将其喂给幼龙们分食
部落战斗大师格鲁希纳克

entries.source: An old orc, covered in battle scars, he looks fierce and very, very, dangerous.
entries.target: 一只浑身都是伤疤的年老兽人，他看起来异常的凶残和危险。

entries.source: and mounted on the barracks wall
entries.target: 并将其钉在军营墙上示众

entries.source: The Legend of Garkul the Devourer, mightiest of all orcs.
entries.target: 吞噬者加库尔，兽人最伟大英雄的传奇。

entries.source: This seems to be the 'subject Z' the notes spoke about. He looks human, but this cannot be -- he would be about five thousand years old!
entries.target: 这个似乎是文献中提到的“Z号实验体”。他看起来像人类，但这不可能——他应该有大约五千岁了！

entries.source: and bloodily smeared across the granite walls
entries.target: 并将其血淋淋地涂抹在花岗岩墙壁上

entries.source:
As you approach you come upon an other Wayist and receive a very clear mental message:
#{italic}##UMBER#RUN AWAY! I am done for but you can save yourself still!#{normal}#
entries.target:
当你走向另一位维网信徒，你收到了一个清晰的灵能消息：
#{italic}##UMBER#快跑！我已经完蛋了，但是你还可以得救！#{normal}#

entries.source: #GOLD#You hastily activate your Rod of Recall, vowing to come back later!
entries.target: #GOLD#你匆忙启动了回归之杖，发誓日后再回来！

entries.source: Space around you starts to dissolve...
entries.target: 你周围的空间开始消解……

entries.source: This creature is about as tall as a halfling. It is covered in white silky fur and has a disproportionate head. The weirdest thing about it though, its weapon simply floats in front of it.
entries.target: 这只生物像半身人一样高。它浑身覆盖着白色的丝滑毛发，长着一颗不相称的大头。最不可思议的是，它的武器就那样悬浮在它面前。
